title: Extract Enchants
description: Extract enchantments from tools, weapons and armour into Enchanted Books via crafting, at the cost of destroying the original item.
body:
<center>
  
![image](https://i.postimg.cc/bN6DPrBm/EEBanner.png)

A very basic Minecraft data pack and mod for extracting enchantments from tools, weapons and armour on to Enchanted Books via crafting, at the cost of destroying the original item.

</center>

## Overview

- Extracts enchantments from weapons, tools and armour and places them on to an Enchanted Book
- Consumes the original item
- Supports most (if not all) enchantable items

![image](https://i.postimg.cc/sgYHMP93/SCR-20260629-pzjh.png)

**NOTE:**
Non-enchanted items are accepted by the crafting recipe, producing an empty Enchanted Book. This is a limitation of Minecraft's current crafting system and the method this pack/mod uses.

## Versions

| Minecraft Version | Data Pack Version | Mod Version |
| :--: | :--: | :--: |
| 26.1 - 26.2 | [v0.3.0](https://modrinth.com/datapack/extract-enchants/version/v0.3.0) | [v0.3.0+mod](https://modrinth.com/datapack/extract-enchants/version/v0.3.0+mod) |

Older versions and snapshots can be found [here on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/extract-enchants/versions) or [on GitHub](https://github.com/Classics-Craftworks/Extract-Enchants/wiki/Versions).

Make sure you download the correct version that matches your Minecraft version and mod loader if you are using Fabric or Forge. Please note that **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required to run the Fabric/Quilt mod version** of Extract Enchants.
